remarks: Step into this beautifully updated 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom corner unit offering 708 sq ft of bright, sun-filled living space. This move-in ready home features stylish ceiling lighting, ceiling fans, and hardwood floors throughout. The spacious primary bedroom, with additional access from the rear entrance, includes a ceiling fan/light combination and a generous walk-in closet. The charming kitchen is equipped with a stainless-steel refrigerator, stone countertops, microwave, garbage disposal, and gas stove/oven with overhead vent. The newly updated bathroom features sleek white cabinetry and a modern vanity sink. Additional highlights include ample closet space, fresh paint, air conditioning, on-site laundry facilities, and one parking space. Common charges include heat and hot water. Ideally located with easy access to I-95 and the Stamford Metro-North train station, and just minutes from shopping, dining, and all that vibrant Stamford has to offer. Small pets allowed per HOA. Move right in and enjoy comfortable, convenient living - or take advantage of a strong investment opportunity in a high-demand rental area.
